shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣站在一排固定好的气瓶旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a row of gas cylinders chained upright to a wall, smiling at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课：压缩气体的危害。

shots.section_title: 开场
shots.scene: 欣欣敲敲气瓶，表情认真
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gently taps a steel gas cylinder and looks serious.
shots.narration: 看着安静的气瓶，里面压着大能量。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰单手拖着一个没戴瓶帽的气瓶走
shots.prompt_en: The young male student drags an uncapped gas cylinder across the floor with one hand, the cylinder tilting.
shots.narration: 阿杰拖着气瓶就走，瓶帽也没戴。

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 小研快步上前扶住气瓶
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student hurries over and steadies the tilting cylinder with both hands.
shots.narration: 小研赶紧扶住：这可不是普通铁罐！

shots.section_title: 情景
shots.scene: 阿杰挠头疑惑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head looking puzzled next to the cylinder.
shots.narration: 气瓶到底危险在哪？

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 实验室里的气相色谱、手套箱、反应装置接着气路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas chromatograph, a glove box and a reaction setup connected by thin gas lines to cylinders. No text.
shots.narration: 做分析、保护、反应，都离不开气体。
overlay: 实验室离不开压缩气体

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 集中供气管道和单个气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a central gas supply pipeline on a wall beside individual gas cylinders in a lab. No text.
shots.narration: 有的集中供气，更多的还是用气瓶。

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 一大团气体被压进一个气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a huge cloud of gas being squeezed into one small steel cylinder by arrows. No text.
shots.narration: 一瓶压进了大量气体，省空间。

shots.section_title: 实验室离不开压缩气体
shots.scene: 气瓶内箭头指向四周瓶壁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder cross section with many arrows pushing outward on the walls, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 正因为压得多，瓶里压力很高。

shots.section_title: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭
shots.scene: 瓶阀被撞断，气体喷出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a falling cylinder striking the floor, its valve snapping off and gas jetting out. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶倒地摔断瓶阀，气体猛喷。
overlay: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭

shots.section_title: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭
shots.scene: 气瓶像火箭一样冲穿墙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder shooting forward like a rocket and breaking through a brick wall. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶会像火箭冲出，能撞穿墙。

shots.section_title: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭
shots.scene: 飞出的碎片击中沿途物品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: broken fragments flying across a room toward people and benches, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 断裂的部件飞出，沿途伤人。

shots.section_title: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭
shots.scene: 【实拍】气瓶戴好瓶帽的特写（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands screwing a protective cap onto a closed cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 不用时戴好瓶帽，保护瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 高压：瓶阀断裂，气瓶像火箭
shots.scene: 压缩空气吹向身体打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a compressed air gun blowing dust off a person's clothes, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 压缩空气也不对人吹，会伤眼伤皮肤。

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 三个气瓶剖面：气体、液体、填料
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three cylinder cross sections side by side, one full of gas, one with liquid at the bottom, one filled with a porous mass. No text.
shots.narration: 气在瓶里，有三种存法。
overlay: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 压缩气体瓶：氮气、氧气、氦气始终是气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder filled only with gas molecules, temperature icons around it. No text.
shots.narration: 压缩气体：氮、氧、氦，始终是气态。

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 液化气体瓶：底部液体、上部气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder with liquid in the lower part and vapour above it. No text.
shots.narration: 液化气体：加压变成液体。

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 液化气体漏出时大量汽化
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small drop of liquid escaping from a cylinder and expanding into a large gas cloud. No text.
shots.narration: 一漏出来，就变成一大片气体。

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶剖面：多孔填料浸着溶剂
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an acetylene cylinder cross section showing a porous filler soaked with solvent. No text.
shots.narration: 乙炔不稳定，溶在溶剂里存放。

shots.section_title: 瓶里的气：压缩、液化、溶解三种
shots.scene: 乙炔瓶必须直立
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an acetylene cylinder standing upright with a tick, a cylinder lying on its side crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 这是为了防爆，乙炔瓶要直立。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置
shots.scene: 【实拍】细高的无缝气瓶与矮胖的焊接气瓶并排（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a tall slim seamless steel cylinder standing beside a short wide welded cylinder.
shots.narration: 气瓶外形不同，承压也不同。
overlay: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置
shots.scene: 高压无缝气瓶：瓶壁厚、很重
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tall seamless cylinder cross section with thick walls and a heavy weight icon. No text.
shots.narration: 高压瓶细高壁厚，空瓶也很重。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置
shots.scene: 低压焊接气瓶：矮胖、有焊缝
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a short wide cylinder with a visible weld seam around its middle. No text.
shots.narration: 低压瓶矮胖有焊缝，装液化气。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置
shots.scene: 【实拍】手指指向瓶阀上的安全泄压装置（关阀）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a finger pointing at the small pressure relief device on the side of a closed cylinder valve.
shots.narration: 瓶上有安全泄压装置，防超压。

shots.section_title: 高压气瓶、低压气瓶与泄压装置
shots.scene: 气瓶受热，泄压装置排气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder near a heater with a small vent releasing gas from the relief device, a thermometer rising. No text.
shots.narration: 受热超压时它会排气，别遮挡。

shots.section_title: 危害看种类：一种气常兼几种危害
shots.scene: 四个气瓶分别配火焰、圆圈火焰、骷髅、腐蚀图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four cylinders each with a hazard pictogram: flame, flame over circle, skull and corrosion. No text.
shots.narration: 气体危害，先看是哪一类。
overlay: 危害看种类：一种气常兼几种危害

shots.section_title: 危害看种类：一种气常兼几种危害
shots.scene: 气瓶旁加一个缺氧人形图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cylinder beside a person outline with a falling oxygen level indicator. No text.
shots.narration: 还有一类：挤走氧气，让人窒息。

shots.section_title: 危害看种类：一种气常兼几种危害
shots.scene: 一种气体同时贴两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one cylinder carrying two hazard pictograms, one large and one smaller. No text.
shots.narration: 一种气，常兼主次几种危害。

shots.section_title: 危害看种类：一种气常兼几种危害
shots.scene: 丙烷：火焰图标加缺氧图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a propane cylinder with a flame pictogram and an oxygen shortage icon. No text.
shots.narration: 比如丙烷，易燃，也能致窒息。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源
shots.scene: 氢气、甲烷、乙炔气瓶配火焰图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three cylinders labelled only with flame pictograms and a small molecule icon each. No text.
shots.narration: 氢气、甲烷、乙炔，都是易燃气体。
overlay: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源
shots.scene: 易燃气瓶放在通风处，远离明火和电热设备
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a flammable gas cylinder in a ventilated area, an open flame and a hot plate kept far away. No text.
shots.narration: 放在通风处，远离明火和热源。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源
shots.scene: 一点静电火花引燃气体
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a tiny static spark from a fingertip igniting a gas cloud, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 一点静电火花，也能把它点着。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源
shots.scene: 甲烷无色无味，人闻不到
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an invisible gas cloud around a person sniffing with a question mark. No text.
shots.narration: 甲烷无色无味，闻不到不等于安全。

shots.section_title: 易燃气体：通风，远离一切火源
shots.scene: 气体积聚遇火源爆燃
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gas accumulating in a closed room and a light switch spark causing a burst of flame. No text.
shots.narration: 积聚起来遇到火源，就会燃爆。

shots.section_title: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂
shots.scene: 氧气瓶旁的火焰变得更旺
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen cylinder next to a small flame that grows into a large fierce flame. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气不自己燃烧，却让火更猛。
overlay: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂

shots.section_title: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂
shots.scene: 氧气瓶与可燃气瓶分开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oxygen cylinder and a flammable gas cylinder separated by a wall icon. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气要和可燃气体、可燃物分开。

shots.section_title: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂
shots.scene: 油污手套伸向氧气瓶阀，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an oily glove reaching for an oxygen cylinder valve, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气瓶和阀门严禁沾油脂。

shots.section_title: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂
shots.scene: 漏氧后衣服和头发吸附氧气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: oxygen leaking near a person, clothing and hair glowing with absorbed oxygen, warning triangle. No text.
shots.narration: 氧气泄漏，衣服头发会吸满氧。

shots.section_title: 氧气助燃：远离可燃物和油脂
shots.scene: 富氧环境中先通风，远离火源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: windows opened and a flame icon crossed out in a room with an oxygen leak. No text.
shots.narration: 这时遇火极易燃烧，先通风禁火。

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 有毒气体从口鼻、皮肤、眼睛进入
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: toxic gas entering a person outline through the nose, mouth, skin and eyes, skull icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有毒气体，吸入、沾到都危险。
overlay: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 时钟走过，人才出现不适
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a clock moving forward and a person feeling unwell later. No text.
shots.narration: 症状可能过一阵才出现。

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 接触后报告并就医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person reporting to the older man and then going to a clinic. No text.
shots.narration: 当时没感觉，也要报告、就医。

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 氨、氯化氢灼伤皮肤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: corrosive gas from a cylinder burning the skin of a forearm, corrosion pictogram. No text.
shots.narration: 氨、氯化氢等腐蚀气体灼伤皮肤。

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 气体遇水汽变成酸雾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas meeting water droplets and turning into an acidic mist, corrosion icon. No text.
shots.narration: 有的气遇水才腐蚀，要防潮。

shots.section_title: 有毒、腐蚀气体：中毒可能延迟
shots.scene: 有毒气体专人管理、登记使用
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked gas cabinet with a blank logbook and a responsible person holding a key. No text.
shots.narration: 有毒气体从严管：专人管、登记用。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体也会让人窒息
shots.scene: 氮气、氩气、氦气、二氧化碳气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three cylinders with small molecule icons and an oxygen shortage symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 氮气、氩气、氦气，不燃也不毒。
overlay: 惰性气体也会让人窒息

shots.section_title: 惰性气体也会让人窒息
shots.scene: 泄漏气体挤走房间里的氧气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: leaking gas pushing oxygen molecules out of a small closed room. No text.
shots.narration: 大量泄漏，会挤走空气里的氧气。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体也会让人窒息
shots.scene: 人在缺氧房间里突然晕倒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person in a small room fainting suddenly without warning signs, oxygen level low. No text.
shots.narration: 缺氧没有预兆，人会突然晕倒。

shots.section_title: 惰性气体也会让人窒息
shots.scene: 小房间用气要通风，有缺氧报警
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small gas room with an exhaust fan and an oxygen monitor on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 小房间用气，要通风、装报警。

shots.section_title: 用气之前：先培训，读懂SDS
shots.scene: 王老师给学生上气瓶培训课
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator teaches a gas cylinder training class to students, pointing at a cylinder model.
shots.narration: 碰气瓶之前，先完成气瓶培训。

shots.section_title: 用气之前：先培训，读懂SDS
shots.scene: 翻开气体的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a safety data sheet booklet opened beside a gas cylinder, a magnifier over a blank page. No text.
shots.narration: 先读安全技术说明书，弄清特性。

shots.section_title: 用气之前：先培训，读懂SDS
shots.scene: SDS 放进文件夹存档
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank safety data sheet placed into a labelled binder on a shelf. No text.
shots.narration: 每种气体的说明书，存档备查。

shots.section_title: 用气之前：先培训，读懂SDS
shots.scene: 气体只通入通风柜或密闭装置
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas line running into a fume hood and a sealed apparatus, open bench release crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 只在通风柜和密闭装置里用气。

shots.section_title: 用气之前：先培训，读懂SDS
shots.scene: 用气时戴护目镜和手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the female graduate student wearing safety goggles, gloves and a lab coat next to a cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 用气戴护目镜、手套，穿实验服。

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 气瓶旁的特种设备图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas cylinder with a special equipment badge icon and a law book. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶是特种设备，按国家规定管理。
overlay: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 从有资质的供气单位租用气瓶
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a gas supply truck from a licensed supplier delivering cylinders, a blank license card. No text.
shots.narration: 从有资质的单位买气、租瓶。

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 来路不明的气瓶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unmarked dirty cylinder of unknown origin left at the door, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 来路不明的气瓶，不收不用。

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 涂改钢印、自行充装打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand repainting a cylinder and a hand refilling it from another cylinder, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 严禁涂改，严禁自行充装。

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 台账上记录气瓶和检验到期
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank cylinder logbook with a calendar icon and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 建台账，检验到期提前换瓶。

shots.section_title: 气瓶是特种设备，按规定管理
shots.scene: 实验室只留够用的气瓶，空瓶退回
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab with only two cylinders in use, extra and empty cylinders going back on a supplier cart. No text.
shots.narration: 只留够用的，空瓶及时退回。

shots.section_title: 气瓶事故大多可以预防
shots.scene: 事故原因五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: five icons, a messy storage corner, a leaking valve, a wrong connection, a dented cylinder and a dragged cylinder. No text.
shots.narration: 储存不当、泄漏、装错、损坏、搬错。
overlay: 气瓶事故大多可以预防

shots.section_title: 气瓶事故大多可以预防
shots.scene: 对应的防范措施一一打勾
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a checklist with five ticks next to a chained cylinder, a cap, a trolley and a regulator. No text.
shots.narration: 这些事故，大多本可以避免。

shots.section_title: 气瓶事故大多可以预防
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up next to a properly chained cylinder with its cap on.
shots.narration: 储存、搬运、使用，按规程做到位。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 高压、火箭、瓶帽图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a pressure gauge, a rocket shaped cylinder and a cylinder cap. No text.
shots.narration: 高压能量大，瓶帽护瓶阀。

shots.section_title: 小结
shots.scene: 易燃、氧化、有毒、窒息四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a flame, a flame over circle, a skull and an oxygen shortage symbol. No text.
shots.narration: 认清气体：易燃、助燃、有毒、窒息。
